results.label: Safe count donation to partner versus opponent-winning count donation
results.proxy_note: Uses v0 `count_donation_to_partner/opponent` action tags; cannot prove bidder-partner intent or hidden future overtrump risk.
results.source_claim: Count should be given to the bidder/partner only when the partner is guaranteed to win.
results.status_reason: No paired decisions expose both the preferred and alternative proxy actions.

results.label: Partner donation without trump-in versus count dumped while trumping in
results.proxy_note: Uses public action tags for count donation and trump-in; it does not know whether the led trump was a deliberate partner trap.
results.source_claim: Low trump leads can be traps; count dumped into uncertain trump-in windows can swing the hand.
results.status_reason: No paired decisions expose both the preferred and alternative proxy actions.

results.label: Winning the current trick versus non-winning alternatives
results.proxy_note: Measures trick-capture value generally; v0 tags do not isolate bidder's partner or future support lead value.
results.source_claim: The partner should actively try to win tricks and take lead when supporting the bidder.
results.status_reason: Paired confidence interval crosses zero or sample is too small for a status move.

results.label: Virtual boss off-suit tile versus lower live off-suit tile
results.proxy_note: Uses public live-higher-suit tag as a virtual-boss proxy; does not distinguish all reasons a non-double off tile is attractive.
results.source_claim: A middle-ranking tile can become an effective double when all higher same-suit tiles have been played.
results.status_reason: Preferred proxy has higher paired oracle regret on this public-state slice.

results.label: Low-liability off lead versus count-exposing off lead
results.proxy_note: Uses live-count-by-led-suit proxy only; it is not a full expected-count-exposure model.
results.source_claim: If partner wins lead without a double, the next lead should minimize expected live count exposure.
results.status_reason: Paired confidence interval crosses zero or sample is too small for a status move.

results.label: Off lead versus trump lead from lead position
results.proxy_note: Measures ordinary lead-position trump/off tension; v0 tags do not identify bidder's partner, bidder trump length, or exception regimes.
results.source_claim: The bidder's partner should usually avoid leading trump, except when every off lead risks major count.
results.status_reason: Paired confidence interval crosses zero or sample is too small for a status move.

statistical_method: Candidate-action and paired-decision oracle E[Q] regret slices. Means use nonparametric bootstrap 95% confidence intervals; paired contrasts use per-decision best preferred proxy regret minus best alternative proxy regret.
